response.sql: WITH equipment_avg AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), all_equipment AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS reference_avg FROM equipment_avg), kept AS (SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity FROM equipment_avg e CROSS JOIN all_equipment a WHERE e.avg_humidity > a.reference_avg), kept_equipment AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS reference_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.equipref, k.avg_humidity, k.avg_humidity - a.reference_avg AS above_all_equipment_avg, ABS(k.avg_humidity - m.reference_avg) AS distance_from_kept_avg FROM kept k CROSS JOIN all_equipment a CROSS JOIN kept_equipment m WHERE a.reference_avg IS NOT NULL AND m.reference_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY distance_from_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: "How far" means absolute distance. LIMIT 10 returns fewer rows if fewer than 10 equipment references qualify.

alternatives.interpretation: The last value is a signed difference from the kept-equipment mean.
